_doc: Design tokens of every controller (README.md). The palette and sizes equal the :root of web/app_shell.css, which stays the page's source for now; tools/design_tokens.py --check fails when the two drift apart. A view (views/<name>/view.json) adds its own colours on top.

font._doc: Nunito (OFL) for text, Material Symbols Rounded (Apache-2.0) for icons, both in fonts/. Pages embed the woff2 subsets from fonts/generated/web, panels compile the LVGL fonts from fonts/generated/lvgl.
